discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_18/section_18.9/cis_18.9.19.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_18/cis_18.9.19.x/cis_18.9.19.7.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

No runnable check (deletes the whole key); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "18.9.19.7 | PATCH | Ensure Turn off background refresh of Group Policy is set to Disabled"
  when: win11cis_rule_18_9_19_7
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_18.9.19.7
    - logging_and_tracing
    - NIST800-171_3.13.1
    - NIST800-171_3.13.2
    - NIST800-171_3.4.1
    - NIST800-171_3.4.2
    - NIST800-171_3.4.6
    - NIST800-171_3.4.7
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2
    - NIST800-53R5_CM-1
    - NIST800-53R5_CM-2
    - NIST800-53R5_CM-6
    - NIST800-53R5_CM-7
    - NIST800-53R5_CM-7_1
    - NIST800-53R5_CM-9
    - NIST800-53R5_SA-10
    - NIST800-53R5_SA-3
    - NIST800-53R5_SA-8
  block:
    - name: "18.9.19.7 | PATCH | Ensure Turn off background refresh of Group Policy is set to Disabled | Remove the stray subkey written by earlier role versions"
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Currentversion\Policies\System\DisableBkGndGroupPolicy
        state: absent
        delete_key: true

    - name: "18.9.19.7 | PATCH | Ensure Turn off background refresh of Group Policy is set to Disabled | Remove the value from the policy key"
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Currentversion\Policies\System
        name: DisableBkGndGroupPolicy
        state: absent
